rulesTitle: Contract rules / change the threat model
rulesHint: Shape the run before deployment. These rules affect the real simulation.
inverseHint: A harder attack surface with increased bounty and experience.
arcanaHint: Allow forbidden knowledge and its timed choices.
limitBreakHint: Keep scaling individual weapons after a completed build.
confrontationHint: Extraction waits for the final privileged process to die, even beyond the deadline.
eggsHint: Apply this operator's installed golden payloads.
augmentHint: Permanent increments belong to one operator. Switch operators to invest in a different build.
augmentApplied: Golden payload installed. Its stat increment applies to this operator's next run.
sealHint: Seal discovered weapons to remove them from future random choices. Your operator always keeps their starting weapon.
sealFull: Seal capacity reached. Unseal another weapon first.
arsenalTitle: Choose the primitive. Own the outcome.
arsenalHint: One legal weapon, chosen deliberately. Seals, unlocks and arsenal limits still apply.
operationSaved: Operation progress and its research budget have been saved separately.
